summary: Short careers page (5 blocks): a slim photo head, a plain job list (title, place, Apply now), six reasons to join, a team photo call-to-action and a grid of six employee voice cards. Needs 3 or more open roles with places, six benefits and six staff names with tenure.

centered heading and line; three by two white cards with a red line icon, title and one or two lines
